source: maplestory.io (GMS 270) — skillbook API + raw WZ API
notes: Beginner book job 6000 was pulled via the raw WZ API: the skillbook API fails it on every attempt (WZProperty cast error, 3 attempts), like jobs 6001/6002/10000.

Kaiser's 5th-job set is the 4 class-specific actives (Nova Guardians, Bladefall, Draco Surge, Dragonflare) with sub-entries; no shared Warrior V skill is included by any Warrior class in this dataset, and all-class common V skills plus Might of the Nova are out of scope as in every other completed class.

HEXA book 6114 was re-pulled complete (20 skills): the staged pull was truncated at 10 and missed the Origin Nova Triumphant, Pyroclastic Instinct, HEXA Stone Dragon, HEXA Wing Beat and extra HEXA Inferno Breath entries. Skill 61141016 does not exist in the book.
Six Beginner skills in job 6000 are invisible variants with no name in String/Skill.img; listed as skill-<id> with their frames.
Ball frames are projectile sprites preserved as 'ball' arrays.

WZ fallback repair: a second-pass layer-key bug misfiled a few retried frames under numeric keys (found in 6 skills across the branch, fixed and re-extracted); grapple ball groups (Vertical Grapple 6 frames) are grouped sub-animations, recovered after the fix.
